strategies.name: Paxton Margin Ladder
strategies.description: Stu held a large YES on Paxton winning the nomination outright, then layered four additional margin-market positions on the same race: NO on a 0-5 point Paxton win, NO on a 5-10 point win, and YES on a 20+ point blowout (the Pantheon-of-Victory flyer bought at 8 cents). Together they express a single thesis — Paxton wins big — using stacked tiers that pay out at different conviction levels, with the longshot tier (20+ margin) providing the massive upside.

strategies.name: Texas May 26 Primary Night Basket
strategies.description: Stu ran six calls across the same Texas primary/runoff night (May 26, 2026), all sharing the thesis that favorites and rational Democratic voters would prevail. The calls span the Senate nomination, two Democratic House primaries, the AG runoff, and a drop-out side-market, all resolving the same evening. Stu recapped them as a unified scorecard.
